title: Paperbunkr theme (schema version 2)
description: The theme.json at the root of a .crpck package. Editor help only: Paperbunkr validates a theme itself when it is installed and reports problems by JSON path. A file without schemaVersion is a version 1 theme and keeps working unchanged.

id.description: A stable identity for the family, reverse-domain style (org.example.mytheme). The user's own customizations are stored against it, so do not change it between releases.

category.description: "accessibility" lists the theme under Accessibility in the gallery.

mode.description: Only for a theme with no variants block.

variants.description: Variant id (no ':') to what differs from base. An id containing 'oled' or a kind of 'oled' is a designed true-black variant.

ref.description: Another token's path, for example "palette.accent" or "action.primary". Cycles are reported and ignored.

tokenTree.description: Nested objects are flattened with dots: { "status": { "danger": "#E5645A" } } sets status.danger.

palette.description: Raw colours. canvas (or background/bg), ink (or text/foreground) and accent (or primary) are enough for a complete theme: every role not set below is worked out from them.

semantic.description: Roles: surface.canvas|navigation|recessed|default|raised|overlay, text.primary|secondary|muted|accent|inverse, border.default|strong|focus, action.primary|primaryText|soft|hover|pressed|disabled, selection.background|foreground, focus.ring, status.success|danger|warning|info (each with .soft), badge.background|text|soft, chart.series.1-6, glow.color, hero.gradient.start|end, hero.scrim, era.platinum|golden|silver|bronze|modern (each with .soft), reader.chrome.background|border|text|textMuted, reader.background.page|text.

typography.description: Roles: display, heading, body, caption, monospace. A family that is not installed falls back to the built-in font and is reported.

icons.description: Semantic icon name (navigation.home, action.search, reader.next, ...) to "symbol:Name", "path:<svg path data>", or a .svg / image file inside the package.

surfaces.description: Surface (canvas, navigation, recessed, default, raised, overlay) to the name of a material.

components.description: Roles: button.primary, button.secondary, button.ghost, chip, panel.floating.

motion.description: Name to a motion. Built-in names a layout can use without declaring them: fadeIn, fadeUp, scaleIn.

layouts.description: Screen name to a layout, inline or as the path of a JSON file in the package. Screens that publish a layout contract: Home. Layouts apply only when the user turns on Theme layouts.

fallback.description: The flat colour used at Performance quality and whenever the material cannot be built.

source.description: An image inside the package. Never a URL.

states.description: hover, pressed, disabled. A state you leave out is worked out from the normal look.

iterations.description: "infinite" may only change opacity, and plays only at High effect quality on mains power.

then.description: The name of a motion to play afterwards.

keyframes.description: The first is at 0, the last at 1, and the last must be at rest (opacity 1, no offset, scale 1, no rotation).

contract.description: The version of the screen's contract this layout was written for. Home is at 1.

breakpoints.description: The first breakpoint whose width range contains the screen's width applies. Overrides change properties of existing nodes by id; they cannot add, remove, retype or re-parent a node.

anyOf.description: A value the screen publishes, for example "home.hasSections".

layoutNode.description: At most 200 nodes, 12 levels deep, 40 children per node.

id.description: Unique in the layout and stable between releases: breakpoints and the user's own adjustments refer to it.

type.description: A built-in container or element, or a component the screen publishes (Home.Masthead, Home.Search, Home.Greeting, Home.Sections, Home.Section).

motion.description: A motion to play when the node appears.

title.description: The tab header when the node is a child of Tabs. May show published values: "Everything ({home.sectionCount})".

text.description: May show published values in braces: "{home.greeting}". Nothing else is evaluated.

style.description: Text: hero, heading, body, caption. Button: primary, secondary, ghost.

source.description: Image: a file inside the package. Never a URL.

command.description: Button: a command the screen publishes (home.refresh, home.search, home.openLibrary, home.openInsights, home.customize).

section.description: Home.Section: spotlight, needsAttention, continueReading, upNext, recentlyAdded, collections, becauseYouRead, readingList.

provider.description: Extension: the id of a component provider. When it is not installed the node's single child is shown instead.
